cards.title: Laura Dotson & Danny Lumbar wedding — Gibbs Farm
cards.financialSource: Owner estimate of approximately $5,000; Square invoice 000055 paid July 19
cards.notes:
BOOKED — deposit received. Approximately 50 guests, buffet at Gibbs Farm; event time TBD.

Working menu from Gmail:
Cocktail hour: local charcuterie and cheese (bresaola, salami, ham, smoked trout; gouda, aged cheddar, fresh chèvre); tomato jam, pimiento, sesame-free pumpkin hummus made with toasted sunflower seed and olive oil; pickled vegetables; focaccia or ciabatta TBD.
Mains/current direction: tri-tip glazed with roasted tomato, honey, red wine, and duck broth; braised turkey with sage-rosemary gravy and carrots, with cranberry component TBD; marinated winter squash with sage, honey, cider vinegar, fried sage, hazelnuts, toasted buckwheat, and roasted apple.
Sides: mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, butter rolls, fall greens with light herby vinaigrette, parmesan, and focaccia croutons; grilled vegetable dish TBD.
Allergy: Laura has a sesame allergy — no tahini/sesame.
Tableware: mixed in-house plates and silverware are possible; matched settings require rental. Water glasses: 40–50 on hand plus supplementation.
Pricing note: current working menu was discussed around $60/person, while owner now expects total revenue around $5,000.
